title: Solid-phase Submonomer Synthesis of Peptoid Polymers and their Self-Assembly into Highly-Ordered Nanosheets
protocol: Setup a fritted reaction vessel in a fume hood.
Siliconize the glass reaction vessel by filling it with a 5% dichlorodimethylsilane in dichloroethane solution for 30 minutes, then drain and wash once with DCE and methanol.
Add 100 mg of Rink amide resin to the fritted reaction vessel.
Swell the resin by adding 2 mL of dimethylformamide (DMF).
Agitate the mixture by shaking or bubbling for 10 minutes.
Drain the solution by vacuum to isolate the swelled resin.
Add 1 mL of 20% 4-methylpiperidine in DMF to deprotect the Fmoc group.
Agitate for 2 minutes and drain.
Repeat with a 12 minute incubation.
Rinse the resin by adding 2 mL of DMF, agitating for 15 seconds, and draining.
Repeat rinsing 3 times.
Add 1 mL of 0.6 M bromoacetic acid in DMF and 86 μL of N,N'-diisopropylcarbodiimide.
Incubate with gentle bubbling for 30 minutes, then drain and rinse with 2 mL of DMF.
Repeat rinsing with DMF 4 times.
Add 1 mL of 1-2 M amine in N-methylpyrrolidinone.
Incubate with bubbling for 30-120 minutes, then drain and rinse with DMF.
Repeat rinsing with DMF 4 times.
Rinse with 2 mL of DMF after the final displacement.
Repeat rinsing with DMF 4 times.
Rinse with 2 mL of dichloromethane 3 times.
Cap and store the reaction vessel until cleavage.
Transfer all dried resin to a 20 mL scintillation glass vial.
Add 4 mL of trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) cleavage cocktail to the scintillation glass vial and cap tightly.
Shake for 10 minutes to 2 hours at room temperature.
Filter the resin through a disposable, PP fritted cartridge into a new, pre-weighed 20 mL scintillation glass vial.
Add 1 mL of fresh cleavage cocktail to rinse the resin and collect any residual peptoid.
Evaporate TFA by blowing a gentle stream of nitrogen or using a Biotage V10 evaporator.
Redissolve the crude oil in 6 mL of acetonitrile/water 1:1 (v/v) for HPLC.
Freeze and lyophilize.
Record the weight of the crude product.
Store as a dry powder at -20°C.
Prepare a solution of the dry peptoid powder in water with minimal acetonitrile for solubility.
Filter clear solution of crude peptoid product with 0.45 μm syringe filter to remove dust and particles.
Prepare a ˜20 μg/mL crude peptoid solution.
Filter 200 μL with a 0.45 μm filter and inject 20 μL for analytical HPLC and electrospray LC-MS.
Mix 1 μL of ˜20 mg/mL peptoid with 1 μL matrix for MALDI.
Spot 1 μL on MALDI plate and allow to air dry.
Purify the crude peptoid mixture with reverse-phase prep HPLC.
Choose the gradient and column (C4 or C18) based on the hydrophobicity of polypeptoid.
Combine purified fractions.
Freeze the combined fractions.
Lyophilize the frozen material, resulting in a fluffy white powder.
Record the weight of the final product.
Redissolve the lyophilized powder in 100 mM HCl (aq.) with minimal acetonitrile (optional).
Transfer the redissolved powder to pre-weighed glass vial.
Freeze and re-lyophilize the material.
Repeat the freeze and re-lyophilization process 2 more times.
Reweigh the peptoid powder after each lyophilization cycle.
Dissolve the resulting white powder in DMSO to make a 2 mM stock solution.
Prepare 500 μL of 20 μM peptoid solution in sheet formation buffer.
Add 445 μL of Milli-Q water to the glass vial.
Add 50 μL of 10x sheet formation buffer to the glass vial.
Vortex mix the contents thoroughly.
Add 5 μL of 2 mM peptoid stock solution to the mixture.
Gently swirl the solution in the vial.
Cap the glass vial tightly.
Slowly tilt the glass vial from horizontal to upright to form sheets.
Alternatively, gently shake the vial to form smaller sheets with fewer straight edges.
Rotate the glass vial about the horizontal axis slowly for one to three days if high-quality sheets are desired.
Soak a Float-a-Lyzer 100 kD membrane in the desired buffer for 15 minutes (optional).
Load 500 μL peptoid sheet solution into the sample chamber of the Float-a-Lyzer.
Soak the loaded Float-a-Lyzer in 500 mL of desired buffer with a magnetic stir bar at 60 rpm.
Allow dialysis to proceed for 4 hours, exchanging with fresh buffer every hour.
Add 1 μL of 100 μM Nile Red to 100 μL of the nanosheet solution to obtain a final concentration of 1 μM of Nile Red.
Make a 1% agarose solution in hot water and pour into a plastic Petri dish.
Ensure the agarose solution is approximately 1/8 inch thick and allow the solution to cool undisturbed on a flat surface.
After the agarose sets, use a spatula to cut and transfer 1 cm x 1 cm squares to a glass slide.
Spot 1 μL of sheet solution on the piece of agarose.
Allow the agarose to absorb the buffer for 2 minutes, leaving the sheets at the surface.
Image within 15 minutes.
Load 15 μL of sheet solution inside a 20 mm diameter 0.12 mm gasket on a glass slide.
Cover with a coverslip.
Image sheets under epifluorescence illumination (e.g., an Olympus IX81 inverted microscope fitted with an Andor iXonEM+ EMCCD spectra with a Texas red filter).
Plasma etch silicon chips to aid adsorption of sheets.
Place silicon chips in vacuum chamber of plasma cleaner.
Pump down to 200 mTorr and set RF coil to 18W.
Etch for 2 minutes.
Drop 20 μL of peptoid sheet solution on plasma-treated silicon substrate.
Allow to sit for 3 minutes.
Remove excess solution with tip of Kim-wipe.
Pipette 20 μL of water onto the surface and remove excess solution again.
Repeat water treatment 4 times.
Alternatively, dialyze peptoid sheet solutions against water to remove buffer and salt.
Drop 20 μL of dialyzed sheet solution on plasma-treated silicon substrates.
Air dry sample.
Image sheets with SEM using in-lens detector.
Set beam energies between 1 kV and 5 kV.
Synthesize peptoid H-[Nae-Npe]9-[Nce-Npe]9-NH2 on 100 mg of Rink amide resin.
Perform displacement reactions for residue 1-18 with a 2 M amine solution for 60 minutes.
Perform displacement reactions for residue 19-36 with a 2 M amine solution for 120 minutes.
Convert t-butyl beta-alanine HCl to the free base.
Use phenethylamine directly in the synthesis process.
Use boc-ethylenediamine directly in the synthesis process.
Cleave resin with 95% TFA, 2.5% triispropylsilane, and 2.5% water for 2 hours.
Evaporate TFA from the cleaved mixture.
Redissolve resulting viscous oil in acetonitrile:water 1:1 (v/v).
Confirm product purity by analytical RP-HPLC.
Confirm presence of product mass by MALDI.
Purify crude product using reverse phase HPLC with a gradient of 30-60% acetonitrile in water containing 0.1% TFA over 60 minutes at 10 mL/min.
Combine purified fractions based on purity from analytical RP-HPLC.
Lyophilize combined purified fractions to yield fluffy white powder.
Confirm the molecular weight of purified block-charge peptoid by MALDI analysis.
Mix 1 μL of 100 μM purified peptoid in acetonitrile:water 1:1 (v/v) with 1 μL of matrix (5 mg/mL α-cyano-4-hydroxycinnamic acid in acetonitrile:water 1:1 v/v and 0.1% TFA).
Spot 1 μL on the MALDI plate.
Place the sample in an Applied Biosystem/MDS SCIEX 4800 MALDI TOF/TOF Analyzer for analysis.
Dissolve lyophilized purified block-charge peptoid powder in DMSO to make a 2 mM stock solution.
Store the stock solution at 4°C.
